how: Sit tall, one hand on the belly. Snap the belly in for a short, strong exhale through the nose, then let go so the inhale happens on its own. Out is active, in is passive. Show 5 slow ones, then 20 at about one per second. Breathe all the way in, hold for a moment, release slowly and notice the tingle. Round two: 20 to 30, a little quicker if it feels good.
name: Kapalabhati
notes: Safety, always say it: stop if dizzy. Go gently or skip with pregnancy, high blood pressure, heart conditions or recent belly surgery. Keep the shoulders still; rhythm matters more than speed. In work settings keep rounds to 20 to 30. Cousin: Breath of Fire (Kundalini, equal active in and out).
